title: People mapping table
description: sources/peoples.json: one row per source term, giving the people value an entry records for it. The set of `people` values is the only set the validator accepts in an entry (rule R-PEOPLE).

term.description: The term as printed (variant spellings comma-separated).

sources.description: Manifest source ids where the term appears.

people.description: The value peoples_regions[].people takes. Same rule as the entry schema's People: never Slavic, Slav, Slavs or Slavonic.

region.description: Optional region text the row suggests; the entry's region keeps the source's own word.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences, citing the usage.

note.description: What a reader might object to.

pilot.description: How the ten pilot entries' existing flags would change under this row. The pilot entries are not re-run or edited.
